verdict.rationale: Fireflies claims meeting-to-meeting automatic language switching and lists a 'Multi-language Mode' on its pricing page, which covers the core of non-English meetings. The evidence is thin marketing copy only, and the summary side of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: number or list of supported languages, explicit mid-meeting language switching, non-English summaries, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy.
